purpose: Test lineage when a provision is physically moved within the same act and no correlation table supplies the mapping. Official later acts explicitly state the move.

official_evidence.observation: The authentic implementing regulation states that, following the amendments of Article 97 of Regulation (EU) No 1308/2013 by Regulation (EU) 2021/2117, the provisions previously in paragraph 3 were moved to paragraph 4.
The authentic delegated regulation independently states that addition of a new paragraph 3 caused the existing paragraph 3 of Article 97 to become paragraph 4.
The authentic modifying act replaces Article 97 paragraphs 2, 3 and 4, providing the operative mutation that created the post-amendment structure.

confidence.rationale: Two later authentic EU acts independently and explicitly identify the old and new paragraph positions, and the authentic modifying act supplies the operative structural mutation.

expected_structural_edge.notes: This is a move of provisions between immutable text states of the same CELEX work, not a new persistent provision object.

forbidden_inferences: Do not treat Article 97(3) as a persistent object whose identifier merely changed in place.
Do not require a correlation table before recording high-confidence structural lineage when authentic official narrative evidence explicitly states the move.
Do not infer proposition-level semantic continuity solely from the structural move; RULE_LINEAGE remains separately anchored.
architecture_result: Lineage reconstruction needs an official-narrative evidence channel in addition to correlation tables and amendment instructions. A same-act move still creates distinct Provision Instances across text states connected by a MOVED_TO edge.
